Title: Appointments allows negative Consultation Fee and saves record without validation
Preconditions: User logged in as team40 and on Appointments module with an editable appointment record
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open https://team40.qaaerp.com 2. Login with ID team40 and password vASPFtSh4d 3. Click Appointments card/module 4. Open first appointment row (APT/0005) 5. In Consultation Fee, enter -25.00 6. Click Save manually 7. Reload the appointment record
Expected Result: System should reject negative Consultation Fee values and display validation error; record should not be saved with a negative fee.
Actual Result: Negative Consultation Fee value (-25.00) is accepted, saved, and persists after page reload. No validation error is shown.
